rows.en: Um, I don't think we've actually done anything yet...
Hm? You say something?
No, nothing at all. Thank you very much!
Mm. Get home safe. See ya.
(What was Gary-sensei even trying to do...)
(We were supposed to meet on the roof today...)

No, I just got here myself.
Thanks for coaching my training again today!
Looks like the girls' swim team is using it...
Sensei, so, what are we doing?
Sensei, we got kicked out...
Um, we haven't actually done anything yet...
(I wonder what Gary-sensei was even trying to do...)
(Sensei said to meet on the roof again today, right...)
rows.notes: Male only; subject (Gary) restored from context.

rows.en:
Mm. Then go get changed right away
and meet me at the pool!

What?!
Again? Then why did we meet on the roof...
Quit your yapping. Come on, let's go!

We got kicked out by Hilda-sensei again,
just like I thought...

Yeah... I guess...
Let's call it a day...
O... okay...
(What is Gary-sensei seriously trying to do...)
(Sensei said to meet on the roof again today...)
(What is Gary-sensei seriously trying to do?)

(We're meeting at the simulator today.
Maybe this is finally some real training...)
Hey, you're here, \p!
Yes. Thanks for coaching me again today.

Mm. Today, we'll be doing hands-on training
using the simulator. So stay sharp!
(Looks like I finally get to do some actual training.)
First I'll show you how it's done, so watch closely.
Yes, understood.
Set the simulator's difficulty to 'Maximum'.
What?! Will you be okay?

You idiot!
You think a toy like this could get the better of me?
Sorry, I'll change the setting.
Time to sortie.
(Oh, here it goes!)
Too slow!
(I wonder how good Sensei is...)
And one more for good measure!
(Amazing...)
You're not getting away.
(He really is something...)
This is the last one!
(He did it! But this simulator...)
rows.notes: Male only; thought continues in c05206 and c05208.

rows.en: Easy, easy.
(...the difficulty's set so high that...)
Come on iiin~
rows.notes: 'Irasshaai': taunting a target into his sights.

rows.en: (...I can't even tell what's going on...)
Yahooo!
(And I'm supposed to learn from this...?)

Phew. Well, it's been a while,
so I guess that's about it.
Sensei! That was amazing!
This is nothing compared to the real me, though...

On the battlefield, even my own side called me
'the Hound of He...'
...Nah, let's skip the old war stories...
rows.notes: Male version. 'Jigoku no ban...' is cut off mid-word (likely 'jigoku no banken', hound of hell); English cut at the matching point.

rows.en:
(No idea what that was about,
but it sounds impressive...)
So, now for my training...

Ah, right, that.
Then set the difficulty to something reasonable
and get to it.

Oh yeah, when you're done, do maintenance
on the equipment. And don't forget
to switch the power off at the end!
Oh, uh...
Knock off whenever you feel like it. See ya.

(Gary-sensei... didn't he just want
to have fun himself...?)

(We're meeting at the simulator today.
Maybe this is finally some real training...)
(Looks like I finally get to do some actual training.)
Yes, understood!
(Ah, here it goes!)
(That's Sensei for you.)
(Yes, he did it! But this simulator...)
(And using this as a model is kind of...)
Sensei! You're amazing!

On the battlefield, even my own side called me
'the Hound of He...'
Nah, let's skip the old war stories...
rows.notes: Female version; same reading as c05214.

rows.en:
(No idea what that was about,
but it sounds amazing...)
So, now for my training...

Oh yeah, when you're done, do maintenance
on the equipment. And don't forget
to switch the power off at the end!

(Gary-sensei... maybe he just wanted
to have fun himself...)

(We were supposed to meet at the simulator
again today, right...)

No, not really.
Thanks for coaching my training again today!
Mm. Then first, I'll show you how it's done...
Um... I think we can skip the demonstration now...
That so? Then I'll watch, so go ahead and start.
O-okay.
Sensei! How was that?!
rows.notes: Both genders; Gary answers in slice 71.

uncertain: c05214/c05230: Gary's cut-off epithet 'jigoku no ban...' read as 'jigoku no banken' (hound of hell) and cut as 'the Hound of He...'.
c05207: Gary's 'irasshaai' in the simulator rendered 'Come on iiin~' (taunting the enemy).
c05174/c05182: 'tte itteta' given the subject 'Sensei' (Gary set the meeting place).
